description: Create an Airflow DAG for travel_booking that scrapes fare data from 25 supplier endpoints in parallel and then consolidates results. The DAG should: (1) fan out one extract task per supplier using dynamic task mapping, limited by a pool 'supplier_api' with 5 slots and by max_active_tis_per_dag, (2) give heavier suppliers priority_weight so they start first, (3) fan in to 'consolidate_fares', which must run when at least 20 suppliers succeeded, (4) deduplicate overlapping fares across suppliers keeping the lowest price per (route, travel_date, cabin), (5) publish and record the list of missing suppliers.

schema.source: supplier REST endpoints listed in config.suppliers

edge_cases: consolidate must count successful upstream map indexes itself; trigger rules cannot express 'at least 20 of 25'
Prices arrive in different currencies and must be converted to USD before picking the minimum
Ties on price must be broken deterministically
A supplier returning an empty list is a success with zero fares, different from a failed supplier
execution_timeout is needed so that one hanging supplier does not hold a pool slot indefinitely
common_failure_modes: FM3: Minimum price chosen across mixed currencies without conversion
FM6: all_done consolidate publishes when only a handful of suppliers succeeded
FM7: Missing suppliers not recorded, so coverage loss is invisible downstream
